text:
Anika: Quick sync — Obsidian Systems asked for a joint perf/W + throughput bench to support their marketplace listing. Target: end-to-end validated numbers + kernel tuning recipe. Proposed sprint: 2 weeks, kickoff Mon Apr 14. Owners: @leo (bench runs), @maya (kernel/runtime), @ben (infra/orchestration), @sanjay (Obsidian eng). Any blockers? :calendar:

Leo: I can lead the bench runs. Need model list, sequence lengths, power telemetry schema, and SSH to their lab. Also, do we measure at board DC-in or rack PDU? :thinking:

Sanjay (Obsidian): NDA is signed. We'll provide both board DC-in and chassis PDU traces — recommend board DC for perf/W accuracy but we'll share both. I'll upload credentials and a short lab guide to the shared bucket by Friday.

Maya: I'll own kernel tuning and runtime knobs. Can you share the kernel version, current governor settings, and a baseline perf trace for each model? Typical wins here: scheduler affinities + L2 prefetch + small CUDA kernel launch tweaks.

Ben: I'll provision the Dedicated bench pool and an S3 bucket under redwood-ob-bench. Cost center: Redwood-PS. I'll also wire telemetry into the Console for per-run perf/W dashboards. Need final run matrix to size the pool.

Anika: Initial model list (working):
- gpt2-small — seq 512 (latency + throughput)
- distil-2B — seq 2048 (saturation throughput focus)
- embed-tiny — seq 512 (embeddings perf/W)
Run types: 1) cold latency (single-request), 2) warmed latency (KV primed), 3) saturation throughput (concurrent 64). We want perf/W at each point + thermals. I'll drop a CSV with full matrix.

Leo: Putting a quick run matrix here for clarity:
```yaml
runs:
  - name: gpt2_small_latency_cold
    model: gpt2-small
    seq: 512
    concurrency: 1
    reps: 10
  - name: distil2b_throughput
    model: distil-2B
    seq: 2048
    concurrency: 64
    reps: 5
  - name: embed_tiny_perfW
    model: embed-tiny
    seq: 512
    concurrency: 16
    reps: 20
telemetry:
  - power: board_dc_in, chassis_pdu
  - thermals: per-sensor (cpu,gpu,vrm)
  - perf: tokens/sec, p95 latency
```

benchbot: Created bench job run-1765432130 on obsidian-lab. Link: https://bench.redwood.example/runs/run-1765432130 — logs will stream to redwood-ob-bench/reports/run-1765432130.

Maya: Uploading kernel tune branch: https://github.com/redwood/infra/compare/obsidian-kernel-tunes?expand=1. Patch includes CPU affinity rules, numa hints, and a small nvcuvid launch param. Please test on cloned lab only.

Ben: For marketplace listing we should tag artifacts with `obsidian-certified`. Marketing PM (cc @celine) — want a short blurb and approved numbers before public listing. Also confirm whether Obsidian wants a joint announcement or a marketplace-only tile.

Anika: Good point. Proposed comms plan: internal validation -> partner review -> joint blog + marketplace tile. Tentative announce: 2 weeks after bench completion.

Leo: No blockers from my side once credentials and CSV arrive. I'll run an initial smoke sweep next Tue to validate harness. :white_check_mark:

Sanjay (Obsidian): I'll aim to have credentials, PDU docs, and thermal baseline by Friday. Also sharing a short FAQ about their board revision differences.

Anika: Great — sync kickoff Wed 11am PT (30m). Agenda: run matrix finalization, telemetry schema, release/announce owners. Please add any other items. :rocket:
